units.title: Conventional and Non conventional sources of energy
topics: 1.1. Conventional energy sources.
1.2. Non conventional energy sources.
1.3. Need of non conventional energy sources.
1.4. Renewable Sources of Energy such as Hydro, Solar, Wind, Bio- mass, Tidal and Geothermal - their availability and limitations.
uos: 1.a. State the different types of conventional and non conventional energy sources
1.b. State the comparison between Conventional and Non conventional sources of energy.
1.c. Explain the Need, importance and scope of non conventional and alternate energy resources.

units.title: Bio-mass Energy
topics: 2.1. Introduction to biomass and farm residue, management and briquetting.
2.2. Bio-gas as a source of energy. Benefits of bio-gas.
2.3. Technology of biogas.
2.4. Principles, feedstock, types an design of biogas plants.
2.5. Comparison of plant designs.
2.6. Main parts of biogas plants, digester, gas holder, pressure gauge, gas controlling cocks and meter.
2.7. Selection of biogas model and size. Site selection of biogas plants.
2.8. Appliances of biogas plant - burner, heating plate, lamps.
2.9. Operation, trouble shooting and maintenance of biogas plant. 2.10Safety measures in biogas plant. Biomass Gasification, Different types of biomass gasifiers.
uos: 2.a. Describe Bio-mass energy
2.b. Explain different Types of bio gas plant
2.c. Explain the concept of Energy plantation
2.d. Compare different Types of Biogas plants.
2.e. Explain design of different types of bio gas plants.
2.f. State the Applications of biogas plant

units.title: Wind Energy Technology
topics: 3.1. windmill - vertical and horizontal axis.
3.2. Data required for windmill installation such as meteorological data, geohydrological, agricultural and socio- economic data.
3.3. Site selection of windmill.
3.4. Installation, operation and maintenance of windmill.
uos: 3.a. Describe the scope of wind energy
3.b. Explain different types of wind mills.
3.c. List out data required for wind mill installation.
3.d. Explain the factors to be consider while site selection of wind mill.

units.title: Solar Energy Technology
topics: 4.1. Introduction, significance of solar energy, solar spectral and green house effect
4.2. Principles of thermal collection and storage.
4.3. Classification of solar collectors -flat type collector and concentration or focusing type collectors , and their comparision.
4.4. Introduction to Spy module, its principle and applications.
uos: 4.a. Describe Solar Energy Technology in different Areas
4.b. Explain Flat type solar collector.
4.c. Explain concentration or focusing type solar collectors.

units.title: Solar Thermal Systems
topics: 5.1. Constructional details, operation and maintenance of solar cooker.
5.2. Operation, constructional details and maintenance of solar water heater.
5.3. Operation, constructional details and maintenance of solar still.
5.4. Operation, constructional details and maintenance of solar water pumping system.
5.5. Operation, constructional details and maintenance of SPV system.
5.6. Operation, constructional details and maintenance of solar crop dryers.
uos: 5.a. Explain the constructional details of different types of solar appliances.
5.b. Explain the operation of different types of solar appliances.
5.c. Explain the maintenance of different types of solar appliances.

units.title: Energy Conservation

6.2. Familiarization with the different energy conservation appliances and practices.
6.3. Improved cooking stoves.
